svg.title: One weather question through the agent path
svg.desc: The browser posts the question. FastAPI validates and routes it to the agent. The graph dispatches weather tools and returns their results to the model. Server-sent events update the browser. The request also produces a separate operational timeline.

g.text: Validate the POST, locale and conversation history.
Resolve the place, then request its dated forecast.
Return structured evidence for the next model call.
Display tool chips and text. Log the request timing.
